# Organization and Delegation Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for requirements governing persistent personas, temporary
specialists, channels, delegation, budgets, limits, and independent lineage
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [organization model](../../../docs/architecture/organization-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Identity and Role Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are Product, Engineering, and Quality responsibilities defined without conflating a persona with its backend, process, or session? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003; Architecture §Persistent personas]
- [x] CHK002 Are optional persistent personas distinguished from task-scoped specialists with explicit creation justification and lifecycle? [Clarity, Product Vision §Human and organization model]
- [x] CHK003 Are specialist creation, completion, failure, archival, and exported artifacts/evidence/decisions/memory proposals covered as requirements? [Coverage, Data Model §SpecialistIdentity; Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Is Quality's organizational independence measurable through lineage rather than role name alone? [Measurability, Spec §FR-031/SC-009]

## Delegation Contract Quality

- [x] CHK005 Does every required delegation field have a clear meaning, validation rule, and owning entity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007; Data Model §Delegation]
- [x] CHK006 Are capability and budget grants required to be strict subsets of the parent, including invocation/quota and monetary dimensions where measurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008/FR-020]
- [x] CHK007 Is maximum runtime distinct from task deadline, lease expiry, and termination/archival conditions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007; Data Model §Delegation]
- [x] CHK008 Are rejection outcomes defined for excess depth, permissions, budget, project limit, per-persona limit, and unavailable execution capacity? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 6/FR-008]
- [x] CHK009 Is the specialist prohibition on child creation explicit for direct and indirect requests, with a permitted parent-persona request path? [Clarity, Constitution §IX; Spec §SC-009]

## Policy Limits and Channels

- [x] CHK010 Are minimum, default, and maximum persona/specialist limits stated consistently across spec, plan, policy, and organization docs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004; Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [x] CHK011 Are active identity limits distinguished from cognitive execution and runner-job concurrency limits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014; Organization Model §Policy limits]
- [x] CHK012 Are channel default/maximum counts, depth, direct-child limit, sibling naming, archival, and descendant behavior all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005; Data Model §Channel]
- [x] CHK013 Is the default channel tree clearly a convention that policy-authorized personas may adapt, rather than a fixed workflow? [Consistency, Architecture §Channels and collaboration]
- [x] CHK014 Are policy values versioned and centrally validated so an agent cannot raise a ceiling or scatter compile-time constants? [Measurability, Spec §FR-040; Constitution §IX]
- [x] CHK015 Are duplicate delegation and concurrent organization-creation outcomes defined with semantic idempotency and no partial unauthorized identities? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-024]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 15/15 items on 2026-08-31.
- `[x]` records requirements quality only, never a completed organization implementation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
